Download.hint: Save the image or media of the page you are viewing.
Download.reread: Use the area on screen now
Download.viewMissed: The area on screen does not overlap the image. Move or zoom the image and try again.
Download.noCrop: This image server cannot cut out an area, so only the whole image can be saved.
Download.plainOnly: This image is cropped or turned in the manifest, so the file as the manifest links it is offered.
Download.loadingInfo: Checking what the image server offers…
Download.infoFailed: Could not read the image server's information, so only the image file as the manifest links it is offered.
Download.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the address and copy it by hand.
Download.nothing: Nothing to download on this page.
Download.failedHttp: The server answered with an error ({status}), so the file could not be saved here.
Download.failedAccess: The server refused ({status}); the file may need a login or permission.
Download.failedNetwork: The browser could not read the file here: the server may not allow it, or the network failed.
Download.openFile: Open the file in the browser
Download.degraded: Access to the full image is not granted yet, so this is the lower-quality copy the server shows in its place. The original is not offered here.
Download.authLocked: Access to this image is not granted yet, so nothing is offered for download. Allow access in the viewer first.
Download.capped: This image server lists no sizes and limits the size it serves, so only the image file as the manifest links it is offered.
